clips.title: The story
paras: Bathran's Hair is a rare, delicate herb found among the ruins of Bathran's Haunt in northwestern Ashenvale. Celebrated in night elf lore for its potent restorative qualities, the plant is believed to mend afflictions of the spirit as well as the flesh.

Grown in the shadows of the ancient ruins north of Maestra's Post, Bathran's Hair has long been valued by night elf healers. Unlike common medicinal flora that soothe simple physical wounds, this herb possesses restorative properties said to cure deep ailments of the spirit. When a young night elf in Astranaar falls victim to an insidious, unyielding sickness, the herbalist Orendil Broadleaf seeks strands of this rare plant to brew a vital remedy.
